summary: Iter-23 — Buffer (social) integration + Sender.net switch end-to-end testing. 15/15 backend tests passed (12 contract + 3 deep including a real Buffer post + idempotency check). Admin /admin/dashboard Social tab fully renders all required elements and is correctly placed between Ads and Digests. Maker share-listing endpoint verified at the API layer (returns 200 with results list, persists row); frontend Listings tab visual click could not be auto-driven via my selectors but the underlying API path is confirmed working.
action_items: (USER ACTION — not a bug) Sender.net SPF+DKIM DNS records must be added in the Sender.net dashboard before any transactional email can deliver. The 400 SPF/DKIM error is correctly captured in db.email_events and surfaced via /api/admin/email-status (provider=sender, status=failed, error_code=400, error_body contains 'SPF/DKIM records are not configured').

(Optional) Buffer test posts are accumulating on the live Pinterest/IG/FB accounts during automated tests. Consider gating deep regression tests behind an env flag (RUN_BUFFER_LIVE=1) so future testing agents don't unintentionally spam connected channels.
critical_code_review_comments: buffer_service.create_post fan-out is sequential (await per channel). Acceptable at 3 channels but consider asyncio.gather if channel count grows.

Pinterest auto-board selection is implicit — buffer_service relies on Buffer's default-board behavior. If user adds a second pinterest channel without a default board, posts will silently fail; no UI surface for this yet.

buffer_service._create_one swallows GraphQL 'errors' inside RuntimeError text — _record_event for Buffer doesn't store full structured error payload (only the per-channel 'error' string makes it into db.buffer_posts.results). Adequate for now.

success_rate.frontend: Admin Social tab 100%; Maker share button visually unverified but API path confirmed via test_maker_share_published_listing

test_credentials: Admin: team@craftersmarket.org via issue_admin_magic_token. Maker: iron-and-oak@craftersmarket.org via issue_magic_token.
seed_data_creation: None new. Used existing iron-and-oak published listings. Idempotency test transiently $unset published_at to simulate first-publish then asserted exactly one auto buffer_posts row was created across two notify_listing_published() calls (second short-circuited with reason='already_announced').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_buffer_sender.py (contract) and test_buffer_deep.py (deep — actually posts to Buffer). Run from /app root: `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_buffer_sender.py backend/tests/test_buffer_deep.py -v`. The deep file strips literal quotes from inherited MONGO_URL/DB_NAME env (supervisor exports them quoted). Sender.net 400 SPF/DKIM is EXPECTED behavior — do NOT report as bug; just verify error capture into email_events.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration. Buffer integration (admin status, posts list, manual compose, validation, Pinterest image-required behavior, listing-publish auto-post idempotency, maker share) all work as specified. Sender.net switch correctly captures the SPF/DKIM 400 into email_events and exposes it via /api/admin/email-status as designed.
